title: 'Incorruptible is a design book, specifically the institutional design of organizations that have business components but an underlying mission to benefit the public'
summary: John has posted 337 reviews on Goodreads. He gives Incorruptible five stars and maps it as a design book laid out on a biblical structure: case studies of the corruption problem, then forming a company whose processes protect its mission, then the outside institutions that lock that mission in place, then a closing vision of the wasteland left behind. He also points to the QR codes leading to templated legal documents.
blockquote: "Incorruptible" is an amazing book. Full of good general advice, compelling case studies, and careful implementation detail, "Incorruptible" is getting the full five stars.
